Emily here from the AWS partner team. Samir and I chatted about AsterHealth's interest in a hosted inference offering to accelerate their clinical-document summarization pilot. They flagged requirements around latency, on‑prem options and SOC2 evidence — sounded like a good fit for Redwood Inference.

Can we do a short discovery call next week to align on success metrics and map an initial mutual action plan (who owns what, timelines, and a demo cadence)?

Thanks — happy to join the call from AWS.

Thanks Emily — great to meet you Samir.

We'd love to kick off a 30-minute discovery to:
- Confirm success metrics (latency targets, throughput, data residency)
- Surface security/compliance gating items (SOC2, RFI)
- Propose a short demo that shows latency at pilot scale + private deployment options

Tue 11am PT works for us. Kimberly will own the compliance prep and Karthik will join to map the AWS co-sell responsibilities.

Draft agenda (30m):
1) 5m introductions and goals
2) 10m current architecture & constraints (Samir + security)
3) 10m Redwood overview + demo ask / target metrics
4) 5m next steps / owners

I'll send a calendar invite and a short pre-read (mutual action plan template) after this thread. If you have an RFI or baseline security doc, please attach ahead of the call.

Best,
